primary_inference.kind: circular moving-block bootstrap-t, centred under H0

implementation_history.V0: declared method; the executable could not run the declared Politis-White selector on long-memory input: autocovariances were computed only through lag m_max + K_N while the flat-top window legally reads lags up to M = 2*m_hat <= 2*m_max (WM-IMPL-001; IndexError on the first dependent calibration fixture, 2026-09-04T20:12Z). No number was produced.
implementation_history.V0.1: SAME declared statistical method; autocovariance support extended to cover every lag the declared formula may access (max(2*m_max, m_max + K_N)). No semantic change; no clamping added. IMPLEMENTATION_REPAIR, not a methodology revision.

hypotheses.H0: no positive expected OOS loss advantage of M0 over the null

primary_inference.orientation: d_t = loss_null_t - loss_M0_t = logL_M0 - logL_null; positive mean(d) = M0 improves on the null
primary_inference.block_length_rule: l = clamp(round(b_PPW), H, floor(n/6)); b_PPW = Politis-White 2004 / Patton-Politis-White 2009 automatic block length, circular variant, on the centred differential
primary_inference.decision: p = (1 + #{t* >= t_obs}) / (B + 1); SIGNAL_DETECTED iff mean(d) > 0 and p <= ALPHA

calibration_envelope.rule: STOP if ANY null fixture exceeds type1_max or falls below type1_min, or the pooled dependent-null rate exceeds pooled max, or power is below min. No block-rule or alpha change; a failure is sealed.

hac.hac_lag_derivation: L = H - 1 = 15 - 1 = 14: adjacent H-step outcomes share up to H-1 future increments
hac.variance_formula: LRV = g0 + 2*sum_{k=1..L} (1 - k/(L+1)) g_k, g_k = (1/n) sum_{t=k+1..n} (d_t - m)(d_{t-k} - m); t = m / sqrt(LRV / n)
hac.orientation: d_t = logL_M0(y_t) - logL_null(y_t); positive means M0 improves on the null (higher log-likelihood = lower loss)
hac.limitation: L = H-1 addresses DETERMINISTIC label overlap only. Model forecasts, latent synthetic state and path structure may generate dependence beyond H-1. This synthetic repair does NOT establish the real-market inference contract; real A0 evaluation needs symbol/session clustering, purging and its own dependence-aware inference.

secondary_diagnostics.role: secondary; not binding; not averaged; cannot rescue a failed primary

error_control.family_method: union bound across the five negative controls; no independence between controls is assumed
error_control.justification: max_fp=5 keeps the court's false-fail probability at 0.15% per control (0.76% family bound) at nominal alpha and 1.4% at the pooled envelope maximum, while a control whose realised rate is >= 3x nominal (E[FP] >= 3.75) is more likely than not to be convicted. Fixed before any acceptance outcome.

positive_control_rule.rationale: same frozen rule as V0/V1; >= 40/50 detections and >= 45/50 positive mean gain
